title: Farmer
description: Tilling land, sowing, reaping, and raising animals for a lord or for subsistence.

title: Laborer / Husbandman
description: Performing general labor on an estate.

title: Shepherd / Animal Herder
description: Tending to livestock.

title: Miller
description: Operating a mill to grind grain, a relatively well-off but sometimes 'contemptible' profession.

title: Logger
description: Felling trees and preparing wood.

title: Hunter / Fisherman
description: Providing food through hunting or fishing.

title: Blacksmith
description: Forging tools, weapons, and general ironwork.

title: Carpenter
description: Working with wood to build structures and tools.

title: Stonemason
description: Cutting and shaping stone for buildings, from basic structures to cathedrals.

title: Weaver / Tailor
description: Producing cloth and making garments.

title: Shoemaker / Cobbler
description: Making new shoes (cordwainer) or repairing old ones (cobbler).

title: Potter
description: Making ceramic goods and pottery.

title: Butcher
description: Slaughtering animals and selling meat.

title: Baker
description: Baking bread and other goods.

title: Tanner
description: Processing animal skins into leather (a very dirty and low-status job).

title: Gong Farmer
description: A notoriously dirty job involving the removal of human waste from privies.

title: Messenger / Runner
description: Delivering messages and packages face-to-face.

title: Stablehand / Dockworker
description: Performing manual labor in stables, warehouses, or on the docks.

title: Refuse Picker
description: Collecting waste products from streets which could be used in manufacturing.

title: Inn Keeper / Tavern Owner
description: While some record-keeping might be involved, many smaller businesses relied on simple tally systems or hired a clerk for complex tasks.
